preflight: Ignored-inclusive rg over all maintained individual YAMLs for the four exact strength/name patterns found no literal match; this is a bounded lexical check, not absence of chemically equivalent stocks. Final catalogue validator checks proposed IDs and paths.

deltas.reasoning_append: A bounded nominal stock proposal now preserves the declared source strength without selecting unreported solvent, percent basis or molecular form.
deltas.applicability_append: Proposal ROOT-PROPOSAL-NOMINAL-11 applies only to the listed frozen occurrence context(s). TOGO M2570 specifies a 10 mL aliquot of 2.5% L-cysteine hydrochloride stock prepared under nitrogen and autoclaved before addition. Nitrogen is a preparation atmosphere, not an asserted bulk solute. Solvent, percentage basis and reagent hydrate are unreported; L stereochemistry and hydrochloride are explicit. The frozen G_PER_L quantity is preserved as a source normalization conflict, not used as stock composition.
deltas.missing_requirement: Verify the original ATCC stock preparation, percent basis (w/v or w/w), solvent and hydrate status before proposing a quantitatively defined stock.
deltas.review_requirement: Independent integration reviewer must review this final decision delta and exact new payload; original C review alone does not approve this later root-authored change.

deltas.applicability_append: Proposal ROOT-PROPOSAL-NOMINAL-23 applies only to the listed frozen occurrence context(s). JCM 87 permits 20% lactic acid OR 1 N to 6 N HCl to adjust the final medium to pH 5.6. This proposal denotes only the lactic acid stock alternative. HCl is not a constituent of it, and pH 5.6 is not the stock pH. Percentage basis, solvent and acid stereochemistry are unreported; the amount is determined by the final-medium pH endpoint.
